title: Subset Sum in `O(2^ 0.49n )` time

result.label: Subset Sum in `O(2^ 0.49n )` time
result.statement: Gives a uniform randomized classical algorithm for worst-case Subset Sum in ordinary O(2^ 0.49n ) word-RAM time on polynomial-bit inputs, where n counts the integers. The time bound holds on every execution and success probability is at least 2/3 on every input. Inputs may repeat positive integers; words have O(n+b) bits for maximum input bit length b .
